trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the set and this one unlocks last. It is the capstone of the whole list, so use the Roadmap tab to plan the order that gets you here with the least backtracking.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and this unlocks. It is one of the first trophies on the list, and because it is story-gated, keep a manual save before the mission in case anything goes sideways.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Just keep playing through the story missions and it unlocks when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story progress only — no side content is needed for this one, so it lands naturally as you play through the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep following the story missions and it unlocks at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story progress only — it unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the story finale, so it lands late — do the missable side content first, keep a manual save before the point of no return, and then see the story through to the end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks the moment that mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks the moment that mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It unlocks the moment that mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It unlocks the moment that mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks the moment that mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks the moment that mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long one — every activity, collectible, and challenge in the game feeds into it, so treat the Roadmap tab as the checklist for this trophy and tick things off as you go.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts add up across free roam, so fold them into your travel between missions instead of grinding them all at once. The detail pane shows your PSN progress target of 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types to sample — one session of each is enough, and the trophy unlocks once all 9 have been tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges in total — work through them range by range, learn each one's timing and target pattern, and remember only gold medals count toward the total.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 locations — win one race at each and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins across the race types — re-winning the same race does not move the count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal, take the challenge, and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade game and play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a chain of missions — finish the last one and the trophy unlocks. Keep a manual save before starting the strand, since the missable flag means it is story-gated.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission chain to the end, and keep a manual save before you start it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission chain to the end, and keep a manual save before you start it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger strands are scattered across the state — work through them between story missions and the count climbs to 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission chain to the end, and keep a manual save before you start it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission chain to the end, and keep a manual save before you start it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots — visit each one and meditate there, and the trophy unlocks once the last spot is done.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt targets one specific animal — track it down and take the shot. Keep a manual save before the hunt, since the missable flag means it is a one-off.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — finish any 3 full sets and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. There are 100 spots to hit — the count is the grind, so tick them off as you travel instead of saving them all for the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span activities and world events, so the total climbs as you play broadly rather than chasing one thing.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in a row with your partner present and keep the heat on the whole time — if the wanted level drops, the chain resets.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or encounter counts toward the 100, so the total climbs naturally as you explore.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Warm up your aim at the Shooting Range first, then group enemies together before triggering Combat Focus and drop five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The description points at the airport — get out of VCIA by an unscheduled route. The cited sources do not pin down the exact spot, so treat this as a try-it-and-see and keep a manual save first.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are tanks, and the trophy is tied to dealing with them. The cited sources do not pin down an exact method, so this guide is a pointer, not a recipe.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, stay out of sight lines, and leave before the alarm goes up.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, five clean getaways — plan the escape route before you go in, and count each successful escape toward the five.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit the truck, grab the take, and get clear before backup arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 areas to discover — drive every road and the map fills in as you go.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs, and each one needs one of its operations robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. Keep a manual save first — the missable flag means this is a one-off moment.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive out through the showroom front — the description calls for style, so do it in one clean run and keep a manual save first.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a round at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish it. Keep a manual save first — the missable flag means this is a one-off visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is vague by design — this one unlocks through a partnership moment that the cited sources do not spell out in detail.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count toward 500 — the choices you make across the game add up over time.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail once, then succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange happens — the cited pages describe it as an odd world event, and the exact trigger is not pinned down in them.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Score a knockdown with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until the total hits $250,000 — the count climbs with every laundered bill.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shop spending counts across every store — the total climbs to $100,000 with normal play plus a few big purchases.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register 10 different vehicles in the app — each new registration moves the count.
